summary: Midstream pause inserts ellipsis and mismatched terminator after LB re-balance during slow consumer backpressure
description:
Issue summary:
Customer observed streams where the model output pauses mid-sentence and the service emits a short ellipsis token stream ('...') followed by a control frame with mismatched terminator metadata. The client receives a duplicate final-metadata object but no proper 'end' delimiter, which prevents client SDKs from recognizing stream completion and leaves the session in a half-closed state.

Impact:
Intermittent for a single dedicated tenant (Noteflow) — several production requests per hour see incomplete finalization of streamed responses. Affects UX where the client waits indefinitely for the end marker and sometimes issues a manual reconnect causing duplicate fragments. No tokens are dropped from model generation, but client-side consumers surface concatenated fragments and duplicated final-metadata entries.

Observed timeline:
- First reported by Noteflow support 2026-03-12 22:14 UTC.
- Reproduced internally against prod-us-east under simulated slow downstream (250ms processing per chunk) on 2026-03-13.

Full description of symptoms and why this is different from typical reconnect truncations: 
This behaviour is not a straight truncation or a lost final chunk. Instead the streaming pipeline inserts an ellipsis chunk as a placeholder while the LB rebalances sessions between workers during a backpressure period. The worker that receives the rebalanced session emits terminal metadata that does not use the same terminator nonce used by the original session, so clients that validate terminator equality reject the finalization and remain waiting.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use dedicated tenant Noteflow in prod-us-east with a long-running generation (>=1024 tokens).
2) Throttle client-side processing to ~250ms per SSE chunk to simulate a slow consumer and backpressure on the connection.
3) Force an LB re-balance by toggling an instance out-of-service via API or simulate ephemeral capacity shift (remove one node from the serving pool).

4) Observe streamed output: mid-sentence pause, a short '...' chunk, then a control frame with final metadata where the 'terminator_id' field differs from prior frames. Client SDKs fail to close the stream.

investigation_notes: Initial triage by support: confirmed customer reproducible under backpressure + LB rebind. Captured pcap and SDK logs from Noteflow. SDK timeout not triggered because client did not receive expected end delimiter.

Hypothesis 1: handoff path does not copy terminator nonce from old worker to new worker during session rebind. Worker wv-21 generated a new terminator when it should have forwarded the existing terminator_id.

Hypothesis 2: placeholder '...' chunk is emitted by the API gateway when it detects stalled response and attempts to maintain heartbeat semantics for very long-running streams; placeholder emission logic may be racing with session handoff resulting in mismatched metadata ordering.

Reproduction: reproduced locally using the serving-runtime debug build with session-handshake logging enabled. Observed that session transfer code calls finalize() on the old worker and separately finalize() on the new worker under a race caused by the lb rebind event during in-flight finalization.
Related code areas: session-transfer, sse-terminator, gateway-placeholder-emitter. Candidate PR: serving-runtime PR #1983 modifies session-transfer timing and was reverted in prod two weeks ago.
comments: Aisha Khan (Support) 2026-03-13: Collected SDK logs and PCAP from Noteflow and attached to ticket. Customer confirms issue persists ~5% of long-running streams.

Miguel Ortega (SRE) 2026-03-13: Able to reproduce in canary with load-gen and a simulated slow consumer. Captured worker logs showing two different terminator_id values. Suspect race during session rebind.

Lina Park (Runtime) 2026-03-14: Patch prepared to ensure terminator nonce is preserved on session-transfer and placeholder emission is suppressed until transfer completes. PR linked above. Will run e2e with Noteflow traffic pattern.
Noteflow engineering (customer) 2026-03-14: Provided traces where client saw duplicate final-metadata entries and offered to allow a short maintenance window to test a patched canary.
Miguel Ortega (SRE) 2026-03-14: Scheduling canary rollout to Noteflow customer for 2026-03-15 01:00 UTC; rollback plan ready.
Aisha Khan (Support) 2026-03-14: Updated customer with planned test window and mitigation guidance (client-side timeout 30s + safe-reconnection behavior).
resolution: In Progress - patch created to preserve terminator nonce during session transfer and to defer placeholder emission until transfer ack. Canary scheduled for Noteflow. No global rollout yet.
resolution_notes: Workaround: increase client-side idle timeout to 30s and implement a guard that treats duplicate final-metadata with different terminator_id as end-of-stream if no further tokens arrive within timeout window.

Planned fix: ensure session-transfer atomically migrates terminator fields; disable gateway placeholder emission during active handoff. See PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1983 for patch draft.
Follow-ups: add unit test for terminator preservation, add a metric for placeholder_emitted_during_handoff, update runbook: Stream Resume Runbook to include LB rebind checks.
